# Import the public API from the Doorstop package
from doorstop.core.document import Document, new as doc_new
from doorstop.core.item import Item, new as item_new
from doorstop.core.tree import Tree
from doorstop.common import DoorstopError


# Helper to create a temporary Doorstop project
@pytest.fixture
def project(tmp_path):
    """Create a minimal Doorstop project structure."""
    # Create a document directory
    doc_dir = tmp_path / "docs"
    doc_dir.mkdir()
    # Create a document file
    doc_file = doc_dir / "doc1.md"
    doc_file.write_text("---\nname: Test Document\n---\n")
    # Load the document
    doc = Document.load(doc_file)
    return doc


def test_U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_001_store_requirements_in_a_permanent_and_secure_manner(project):
    """
    Test that a requirement is persisted and the file permissions are 644.
    """
    # Create a new item
    item = item_new(project, uid="REQ-001", content="This is a new requirement")
    # Persist the item
    item.save()
    # Verify the file exists
    item_path = item.path
    assert item_path.exists(), "Requirement file was not created"
    # Check file permissions (644)
    mode = stat.S_IMODE(item_path.stat().st_mode)
    assert mode == 0o644, f"Expected file permissions 644, got {oct(mode)}"
